additional_info.subject: ID0454464-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / P1 170000221] Charger offline CRM:00315003044
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0454464
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: E-load
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P1 170000221
Charger ID / Serial No.:AxZgDW
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution: Router 2 is not connecting to OCPP. I checked all the configurations and in the neighbour charger everything works perfectly. I already tried a reset and factory reset via FW but unsucessfully.
Please go on-site and factory reset it via HW
​​​​​​​If it fails, replace the router.
​​​​​​​You just need to pay attention to the password, if the new Router has a default password written on the back, you must configure it via Companion or follow the next steps:
​​​​​​​Connect to the router via SSH with the following command in CMD (command line)
​​​​
root@192.168.1.1
passwd admin01
​​​​​​​it will say password is too weak
, so write again the same command as above
​​​​​​​
passwd admin01
Restart the charger and it should work plug and play.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
